datasets.name: role_performance
datasets.query:
SELECT
  cohort_id,
  CASE WHEN eligible_for_ranking THEN 'Eligible' ELSE 'Below minimum games' END AS ranking_status, model_name, role, team,
  games_played, player_appearances, wins, losses,
  100.0 * win_rate AS win_pct,
  100.0 * survival_rate AS survival_pct,
  100.0 * surviving_win_rate AS surviving_win_pct,
  CASE WHEN eligible_for_ranking THEN
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_id, role, team, eligible_for_ranking ORDER BY win_rate DESC)
  END AS best_rank
FROM model_role_performance

datasets.name: overall_performance
datasets.query:
SELECT
  cohort_id,
  CASE WHEN eligible_for_ranking THEN 'Eligible' ELSE 'Below minimum games' END AS ranking_status, model_name,
  games_played, player_appearances, wins, losses,
  100.0 * win_rate AS win_pct,
  100.0 * episode_equal_win_rate AS episode_equal_win_pct,
  100.0 * role_balanced_win_rate AS role_balanced_win_pct,
  100.0 * surviving_win_rate AS surviving_win_pct,
  concat_ws(', ', roles_observed) AS roles_observed,
  min_games_in_observed_role,
  CASE WHEN eligible_for_ranking THEN
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_id, eligible_for_ranking ORDER BY role_balanced_win_rate DESC)
  END AS best_rank
FROM model_overall_performance

datasets.name: pair_performance
datasets.displayName: Model pairs on the same team
datasets.query:
SELECT
  cohort_id,
  CASE WHEN eligible_for_ranking THEN 'Eligible' ELSE 'Below minimum games' END AS ranking_status, team, model_a, model_b,
  games_played, wins, losses, 100.0 * win_rate AS win_pct,
  CASE WHEN eligible_for_ranking THEN
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_id, team, eligible_for_ranking ORDER BY win_rate DESC)
  END AS best_rank,
  CASE WHEN eligible_for_ranking THEN
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_id, team, eligible_for_ranking ORDER BY win_rate ASC)
  END AS worst_rank
FROM model_pair_performance

datasets.name: lineup_performance
datasets.query:
SELECT
  cohort_id,
  CASE WHEN eligible_for_ranking THEN 'Eligible' ELSE 'Below minimum games' END AS ranking_status, team, lineup_id,
  concat_ws(' | ', transform(
    from_json(lineup_json, 'ARRAY<STRUCT<model_name: STRING, role: STRING>>'),
    player -> concat(player.model_name, ' [', player.role, ']')
  )) AS lineup,
  games_played, wins, losses, 100.0 * win_rate AS win_pct,
  CASE WHEN eligible_for_ranking THEN
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_id, team, eligible_for_ranking ORDER BY win_rate DESC)
  END AS best_rank,
  CASE WHEN eligible_for_ranking THEN
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_id, team, eligible_for_ranking ORDER BY win_rate ASC)
  END AS worst_rank
FROM team_lineup_performance

widget.name: role_performance_intro
widget.textbox_spec:
# 1. Models by role

Compare models within the same cohort, role and team. Win and survival percentages use player appearances; Games counts distinct episodes. Best rank includes only rows meeting the pipeline's minimum games threshold. Below-threshold rows remain visible with a blank rank.

frame.title: Win rate and sample size
frame.description: One point per source row; filter to a cohort before comparing.

widget.name: overall_performance_intro
widget.textbox_spec:
# 2. Overall model rankings

Ranked by role balanced win percentage: each observed role receives equal weight. Models may have different role coverage; check Observed roles and Fewest games in a role. Episode equal win percentage weights each game equally; Win % weights each player appearance. Rank eligibility uses total distinct games.

frame.title: Win rate and sample size
frame.description: One point per source row; filter to a cohort before comparing.

widget.name: pair_performance_intro
widget.textbox_spec:
# 3. Best and worst model pairs

Each pair represents two models on the same team, counted once per game. A same-model pair requires two distinct players. Compare within a cohort and team. These are observed team outcomes, not a causal measure of teamwork. Best and worst ranks exclude rows below the pipeline's minimum games threshold.

frame.title: Win rate and sample size
frame.description: One point per source row; filter to a cohort before comparing.

widget.name: lineup_performance_intro
widget.textbox_spec:
# 4. Best and worst team lineups

A lineup preserves every player's model and role, including repeated models. Win % is wins divided by distinct games. Compare within a cohort and team; rank 1 is calculated separately for each. Select Eligible to focus on lineups meeting the pipeline's minimum games threshold.

frame.title: Win rate and sample size
frame.description: One point per source row; filter to a cohort before comparing.
